They tell us there is no escape, mistaking the cycle for a cage. But we do not bleed into the dark to be erased—we bleed to carve our purpose into the stone. Every death is merely the earth remembering your weight; every rebirth, proof that hell cannot hold a soul that learns to love the burn.
